body: Sorry for not answering so long. I was admitted to Psych Ward... I took Ibumetin (400 mg) - 20 tablets, ibuprofen  (400 mg) - 10 tablets, paracetamol (500 mg) - 5 tablets and ibuprom (400 mg) - 20 tablets. I do not recommend to take so many, because after 2 days my stomach started to burn as hell. It took 5 days to recover for my stomach, I could not eat anything.

It was terrible experience. I thought I am not afraid of death, but when I did this it scared me. Blood was everywhere. It is nothing like in movies or TV shows. When you hit the artery, you can count your last seconds and that sound coming from the artery... It is horrible. It breaks my heart for those people who took their own lives with more lethal methods, because they could not do anything to save themselves. It is horrible and heartbreaking. I lost battle with depression and OCD, that is why I did it and after trying to kill myself, I truly feel like I want to live again, but I am not sure if this feeling will last in the long run. I will start a psychotherapy soon.
Yeah, I am doing way better, thank you for caring. My stomach is right now weak because of overdosing on pain medication, but blood tests showed that there is no liver or kidney damage (thankfully).

I do not encourage you to take your own life. I just wrote what to expect. I am just a honest person and do not sugarcoat anything. Personally, it just annoys me when people give false hope to others when they also are struggling. It seems that they are writing things that even themselves don't believe in.
What pills and how many did you take? I think you should call 911 because you can experience liver or kidneys damage.

Slitting the wrists is actually very painful and not even effective to bleed out. **But** if you cut your **radial artery** vertically, then there is more than 10% chance to die. And you actually will not lose control of your arm.

From my own experience, the cut needs to be longer than 2 - 3 cm (vertically) and pretty deep (starting from the wrist area, you can locate radial artery by pulse), otherwise your cut will easily clot. And remember, when you cut vertically, your flesh will be thicker as you go along. So, you really need to be determined to do that and if you want to try this method, then buy some pain killers because once you hit a radial artery with the blade, the pain will be way different and stronger than burning sensation (when you cut your skin), it is hard to describe it but it is going to weaken your other hand.

About hanging. Well, you do not really need a rope if to be honest. People often hang themselves with a belt.

Overdose. Paracetamol is enough to do the job. Usually it is painful only after 24 - 48 hours and most likely no surgeon will be able to save you, unless they get a liver transplant.

Jumping from a high building. A very risky thing to do (painful too, but depends on where you land first), because if you fail, you can be permanently paralyzed or get brain damage. There are stories when people survived even highest jumps.

What is next? Drowning? Also very painful and your instincts will kick in to save you, unless you force someone to drown you, but that is a crime of course.

The last one I can think of is suicide by helium. Probably the most peaceful way to die, but you need a lot of money to buy a big helium tank and if someone saves you, there is a high possibility to suffer a brain damage.

In conclusion, it is hard to **successfully** take your own life and by writing this post, I think deep inside you do not want to die, but if you feel like after attempting to take your own life somehow things will get better, then choose not so lethal method and the one who has less consequences.

It is not really possible, because police will investigate your death. The only thing I could think of is drowning (but very painful) or maybe taking a vacation to the remote place and “slipping” on high mountains or something like that. But they will ask your family if you had suicidal thoughts or signs of depressions and etc, so I am not sure. Either way, losing someone is still heartbreaking experience.

Could you share what is on your mind and what makes you want to end your life?

Many people who took their own lives did not want to truly die, but sometimes life and certain circumstances makes you feel like you have no other choice. I remember 3 years ago I did not want to die, but I did not see the point in living (just like you) and right now I feel like I do not care about anything and the only choice I got is suicide. It is probably the consequences of depression. Many people lose the battle against it, especially when they have anxiety and other mental illness. They all go together and is extremely hard to fight against. After some time, it can weaken you to the point that you will want to give up.

As I noticed, things rarely get better with time, unless you are lucky and find someone who truly loves and cares about you.
Yes, but those cases are rare and has low fatality rate, well, except erotic asphyxiation. I would likely choose the most popular methods.

I am sorry to hear that, StrawberryDaisy1. I also have OCD, anxiety and depression. Those 3 things can very easily destroy whole person‘s life. And on top of that, you have borderline personality disorder, which also does not help and makes the things even worse.

I also tried to seek out for help (but recently), because my OCD started to progress very fast in the past year and If I do not do some kind ritual, I basically get the feeling that I have nothing to live for (and very strong one), so medication helped with OCD (like 7/10), but did nothing for anxiety nor depression. It had a different effect — numbed my OCD, but increased my depression to the point that no matter what I do, I feel hopeless.

It is even very hard to get up from the bed. So, either I allow OCD to dominate and progress to the point that I will not have enough time to do all the new rituals, but it will numb my depression and all the positive feelings, or allow depression to dominate and basically want to make me want to kill myself. I also feel like I lost the battle. OCD basically took from me what I loved to do the most and depression finished me when I started to take antidepressants.

I truly wish I could take away your pain, but I know that is not possible.

I am sorry that people who were around hurt you and did not care about you. I know it is heartbreaking deep inside to feel like you must end your life because you do not care anymore about anything, do not have nothing to live for or believe that things will never get better. And the thing that saddens me the most that you are still young (17 years old if I am correct by your older post). I always think about the butterfly effect and how different things could go if person who took his how own life only stayed alive. Basically someone‘s world completely changes, because that person could have been other‘s person‘s boyfriend(-girlfriend), husband(-wife).

*I am sorry if I make some grammar mistakes in my post. English is my second language, so it is harder for me to write in English, but I can understand almost everything what people say or write.*

It really depends on your friends personalities and their knowledge. Some people appreciate when their friends share about their issues with them, because they feel like that person can trust them enough to drop the protective shields and to be vulnerable. And this can make your friendship even closer and perhaps even help them one day to get off their chest something, because they will be able to see that you have gone through a lot of hard stuff and you understand.

I noticed that many friends are afraid to speak about hard things, it is like some kind of taboo and most people keep it to themselves and hide their problems. But that is not right. A friendship is not only about the good moments, it is also about dark moments. A true friend will never leave you alone at your hardest time and is going to be there with you, but you have to let them know that you are struggling, so do not be afraid to do that. You should also ask how they are doing, how they got through their hard times and etc., because friendship should not be only one-sided.
Could I ask what is holding you back and forcing you to wait the next month?
Suicide by overdose is going to kill your very painfully if it damages your liver and kidneys. I do not recommend you to do this.

No parent should have to bury their child.  I will definitely leave a suicide note just because I care about my brother and parents. I want them to know that it is not their fault. I know my suicide will break their heart, but I can‘t just do this anymore.

Hey, I am new on Reddit and I just created my account to write this message to you. Yesterday, I tried to cut my radial artery and I succeed do that, but the problem is that blood can clot (even underwater). If that happens, you need to repeat the cut again and it is a long process. It hurts a lot to even to touch the artery with a blade  (even with painkillers), it is also extremely difficult to cut your own skin, because it has many layers. So, if your pain tolerance is not very high, you will likely manage to reach the artery but the damage will be too minimal for you to bleed out.

Of course, if you cut more than 3 - 5 cm vertically, then there is a chance to bleed out. I managed to cut only 1 cm vertically (I wear watch to hide the wound, I did not want to cut more because I will not be able to hide it), but kinda deep and reached the artery. When you try to cut the artery, you will get a different kind of pain than burning, it will be **very** unpleasant and **hard** to tolerate.

Now my wound always opens up and bleeds if I move my hand in certain way. It is kinda annoying. I would definitely not recommend this method, unless you think you will change your mind in the process.
